title: Intervals with a coach’s voice
description: Hear the switch between walking and running in the session you chose, with the pause and the resume in your hands.

blocks.text: The user wants to hear when the chosen session moves from walking to running and back. Being able to pick a coach they like adds to that practical cue.

quote.text: If you want a coach telling you when to run and walk for intervals, this is pretty great. There are several coaches so you can choose the ones you like, which is more than I can say for the gym down the street.

blocks.text: Convey the change of intervals clearly

Before the start, show the structure and let someone listen to the voice. During the session, announce each change of stage while keeping the pause and the finish within reach. Keep the place when the session is interrupted, so the right moment doesn’t have to be hunted for out on the street.
Separate the guidance from the choice of load
The voice helps someone follow a sequence they have already chosen. It must not quietly change that sequence or promise that one set of intervals suits every listener.
